kept_rows.B03: The advisor generates candidate strategies with its Claude model (plus ranked community strategies from the Atlas library), compiles and backtests each one, and applies an FDR/Yekutieli-calibrated significance bar. Only the single strongest candidate that clears the bar is ever promoted per run.
kept_rows.F13: Positive deltas on risk metrics (Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown reduction) mean the bot improved risk-adjusted outcomes vs holding through. Delta is bot minus baseline; drawdown and volatility deltas are in %.
kept_rows.S14: Override globals or lock parameters against autotuner changes. Stored in alphabot_state.db, keyed on normalized symphony name. A pinned value is stored for the symphony and equals the global today; it will not follow a later global change.
kept_rows.S17: Destructive data operations. Each action is irreversible — use with care.
kept_rows.X03: Runs over every live symphony in the background (this can take several minutes) — reload this tab afterward to see newly-queued proposals below. Also runs automatically on the weekly schedule.

advise_only: Advise only — no trades are placed from this screen. Swap proposals that survive the gate are recommendations only. Apply changes manually in Composer.
crisis_caveat: Correlations destabilize toward 1.0 in market stress. When de-correlation matters most, these estimates are least reliable. Use as a guide, not a guarantee.
cvar_notes: diagnostic, not a signal — do not trade on this
known-low-biased LOWER BOUND on tail severity, not a point estimate
fleet_banner: Fleet correlation alert Dismissal not saved
fleet_modal:
Fleet correlation risk

When many symphonies exit on the same signal at once, the fleet effectively behaves as a single concentrated position. This amplifies drawdown risk — losses that would otherwise be spread across uncorrelated strategies compound simultaneously.

Threshold

>50% of the fleet exiting on one shared reason within ~3 minutes triggers this alert.
frontrunner_risk: Approving a proposal creates a NEW UNDEPLOYED symphony in your Composer account. Nothing is deployed or traded here — Composer's deploy/invest step is a separate, manual action. Review each candidate's deltas below before approving.
logic_change_fdr: Logic-change proposals carry the highest overfitting risk. FDR/Yekutieli correction applied. Survivors are sound-but-unprovable.
settings_credential_warning: Heads up. The dashboard cannot save these fields, and a save that includes one is refused with nothing written. To change a credential, edit the .env file on the host; some keys take effect only after the daemon restarts.
settings_live_warning: Real-money mode. Every trigger will send a liquidation to Composer. Discord receives an audit alert on every panic-stop call regardless of live state.
settings_maintenance_note: Note. This operation deletes fabricated synthetic files. Real captured data is never touched. Do not run while market hours are active.
strategy_builder_risk: Strategy Builder proposals carry the highest overfitting risk. A multiple-testing correction (FDR/Yekutieli) is applied across ALL backtested candidates — raising the number of candidates raises the bar each must clear. Survivors are sound-but-unprovable: a clean gate pass is not proof of a live edge. Strategy Builder proposals are built entirely from scratch, maximising selection-bias exposure.

/ai-advisor: Advisor observationsadvisory only, nothing here moves money
/history: Daily sum of exit alpha (pts, unweighted)

VWAP_BLEED_MULTIPLIER.help: Multiplier on 20d vol used to set the VWAP Bleed Cut threshold.

VWAP_BLEED_TICKS.help: Consecutive ticks required below bleed threshold to trigger.

VWAP_CROSS_HWM_PCT.help: Return needed to activate the VWAP Breakdown defense (System A).

MAX_PARABOLIC_SQUEEZE.help: Stop tightening once parabolic squeeze is armed or breakeven locked.

MAX_SQUEEZE_FLOOR.help: Tightest the stop distance can shrink under the log-time squeeze.

PARABOLIC_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD.help: Tick-velocity threshold that arms the parabolic squeeze ratchet.

TAKE_PROFIT_MC_PCT.help: Aggressive take-profit threshold once MC probability collapses.

TRIGGER_THRESHOLD_PCT.help: Monte Carlo threshold for arming the trailing stop. Lower = bot waits longer before defending.

VWAP_BLEED_MULTIPLIER.help: Multiplier on 20d vol used to set the VWAP Bleed Cut threshold.

VWAP_BLEED_TICKS.help: Consecutive ticks required below bleed threshold to trigger.

VWAP_CROSS_HWM_PCT.help: Return needed to activate the VWAP Breakdown defense (System A).

advise_only: Advise only — no trades are placed from this screen. Swap proposals that survive the gate are recommendations only. Apply changes manually in Composer.
crisis_caveat: Correlations destabilize toward 1.0 in market stress. When de-correlation matters most, these estimates are least reliable. Use as a guide, not a guarantee.
cvar_notes: diagnostic, not a signal — do not trade on this
known-low-biased LOWER BOUND on tail severity, not a point estimate
fleet_banner: Fleet correlation alert Dismissal not saved
fleet_modal:
Fleet correlation risk

When many symphonies exit on the same signal at once, the fleet effectively behaves as a single concentrated position. This amplifies drawdown risk — losses that would otherwise be spread across uncorrelated strategies compound simultaneously.

Threshold

>50% of the fleet exiting on one shared reason within ~3 minutes triggers this alert.
frontrunner_risk: Approving a proposal creates a NEW UNDEPLOYED symphony in your Composer account. Nothing is deployed or traded here — Composer's deploy/invest step is a separate, manual action. Review each candidate's deltas below before approving.
logic_change_fdr: Logic-change proposals carry the highest overfitting risk. FDR/Yekutieli correction applied. Survivors are sound-but-unprovable.
settings_credential_warning: Heads up. The dashboard cannot save these fields, and a save that includes one is refused with nothing written. To change a credential, edit the .env file on the host; some keys take effect only after the daemon restarts.
settings_live_warning: Real-money mode. Every trigger will send a liquidation to Composer. Discord receives an audit alert on every panic-stop call regardless of live state.
settings_maintenance_note: Note. This operation deletes fabricated synthetic files. Real captured data is never touched. Do not run while market hours are active.
strategy_builder_risk: Strategy Builder proposals carry the highest overfitting risk. A multiple-testing correction (FDR/Yekutieli) is applied across ALL backtested candidates — raising the number of candidates raises the bar each must clear. Survivors are sound-but-unprovable: a clean gate pass is not proof of a live edge. Strategy Builder proposals are built entirely from scratch, maximising selection-bias exposure.

MAX_PARABOLIC_SQUEEZE.help: Stop tightening once parabolic squeeze is armed or breakeven locked.

MAX_SQUEEZE_FLOOR.help: Tightest the stop distance can shrink under the log-time squeeze.

PARABOLIC_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD.help: Tick-velocity threshold that arms the parabolic squeeze ratchet.

TAKE_PROFIT_MC_PCT.help: Aggressive take-profit threshold once MC probability collapses.

TRIGGER_THRESHOLD_PCT.help: Monte Carlo threshold for arming the trailing stop. Lower = bot waits longer before defending.

VWAP_BLEED_MULTIPLIER.help: Multiplier on 20d vol used to set the VWAP Bleed Cut threshold.

VWAP_BLEED_TICKS.help: Consecutive ticks required below bleed threshold to trigger.

VWAP_CROSS_HWM_PCT.help: Return needed to activate the VWAP Breakdown defense (System A).
